I will buy chemical fertilizer for this maize plot because the soil in our area is tired and maize needs food to grow strong. I plan to put about 50 kg of nitrogen for each hectare, so for this small quarter-hectare plot that means one bag of NPK and a small cup of urea. I will use my own kept local seed, not the expensive hybrid one, and my children and I will do all the work ourselves — about twenty days over the season — since the plot is small and we have no money to hire help.
